title: Add explicit AND / OR / NOT boolean payload fields to search_code MCP tool and FTS query builder

sections.what: Add explicit structured boolean operator fields (AND, OR, NOT) to the search_code MCP payload and Searcher FTS/hybrid query pipeline so agents can express precise multi-clause keyword constraints without guessing match_all behavior or hitting strict all-token AND failures.
sections.why: Currently search_code only exposes a single flat `query: str` and `match_all: bool = True`. Any multi-concept natural-language query fails FTS (`kw_hits=0`) when `match_all=True` because every token is ANDed, while `match_all=False` turns the entire query into an unconstrained OR bag with no way to require core terms or exclude unwanted ones (NOT). Exposing explicit `must_terms` (AND), `should_terms` (OR), and `not_terms` (NOT) fields in the MCP payload makes boolean intent unambiguous for agents and callers.
sections.how:
1. Extend search_code in src/codesearch/mcp_server.py and Searcher.search / Searcher.keyword in src/codesearch/search.py to accept optional explicit boolean payload parameters:
   - must_terms: list[str] | None (all required, AND)
   - should_terms: list[str] | None (at least one, OR)
   - not_terms: list[str] | None (excluded, NOT)
2. Update fts_expression(...) (or add build_boolean_fts_expression(...)) in src/codesearch/search.py to safely quote each term/phrase for FTS5 and combine:
   - positive group: (must_terms joined with AND) combined with (should_terms joined with OR)
   - exclusion group: NOT (<not_terms joined with OR>)
   - If only not_terms is given alongside query, combine query's positive expression with NOT (...).
3. Enforce not_terms filtering on the semantic vector leg / final fused results as well (via FTS/node text check or candidate exclusion) so negated terms cannot sneak back in via vector similarity.
4. Update AGENT_GUIDE.md and MCP tool docstring to document must_terms / should_terms / not_terms clearly.
5. Add pytest unit coverage in tests/ for AND, OR, NOT, combined boolean queries, quoting/special-char safety, and backward compatibility with query + match_all.
sections.verify: Run pytest on F:\AI\codesearch\tests covering boolean AND/OR/NOT FTS5 expressions, semantic exclusion of not_terms, and MCP search_code payload validation.

acceptance.text: search_code MCP tool accepts explicit boolean payload fields: must_terms (AND), should_terms (OR), and not_terms (NOT) alongside existing query and match_all.

fts_expression / Searcher.keyword compiles must_terms, should_terms, and not_terms cleanly into valid FTS5 MATCH expressions (quoting tokens, joining must_terms with AND, should_terms with OR, and excluding not_terms via NOT).
not_terms also excludes matching nodes from semantic vector candidates (or filters post-fusion) so strict=false never leaks negated terms.
Existing callers using only query + match_all remain 100% backward-compatible.
Unit tests cover AND, OR, NOT, combined AND+OR+NOT, phrase/token quoting, and empty/edge inputs in pytest.

evidence: Added build_boolean_fts_expression and _excluded_by_not_terms in src/codesearch/search.py supporting must_terms (AND), should_terms (OR), and not_terms (NOT) across FTS5 and semantic results.
Exposed must_terms, should_terms, and not_terms on search_code in src/codesearch/mcp_server.py and updated MCP_INSTRUCTIONS + src/codesearch/AGENT_GUIDE.md.
